claims.quote: Schistura geisleri is a small nemacheilid loach widespread in the Chao Phraya river system of western Thailand.

regions.name: Chao Phraya
regions.quote: Widespread throughout much of western Thailand in the Chao Phraya river system, and has been recorded from headwaters of the Mekong in the northern province of Chiang Rai and the Tapi River basin in southern (peninsular) Surat Thani province.
